segments.text: Let's show you the difference between
the same engineering task done on two
different versions of Altium Designer.
The task at hand is to add a second
Ethernet module to the board that is
identical to the first one to the right
of it that is composed of 56 objects.
So, let's get started. On the right, the
engineer is using Altium Designer 23 to
do the task. And on the left, the
engineer is using the new PCB layout
replication tool available with Altium
Designer 25. Utilizing the PCB layout
replication tool took a mere 1 minute
and 37 seconds and only required 10
mouse clicks. While the process without
the tool took 6 minutes and 39 seconds,
requiring 224 mouse clicks and showing a
clear advantage for using Alteium
Designer 25.
